headline: LCC Infotech submits AGM scrutinizer's report to NSE
hook: Routine filing from micro-cap LCC Infotech
summary: LCC Infotech Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report for its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026, to the stock exchange. This is a routine corporate compliance filing for the company. Indian retail investors holding this micro-cap stock should note it as standard procedural disclosure.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no impact on share price.
